text:
Ethan (Finance): Heads-up: nightly usage reconciliation flagged ~93 Stripe payments that show as succeeded but we have no corresponding invoices in NetSuite. Noticed this at 22:40 UTC. Anyone on payments / infra who can triage?

Lina (Payments): I see a spike of webhook failures hitting our delivery retries overnight. Which endpoint did they target?

billing-bot: ALERT: webhook failures detected for /webhooks/netsuite 22:33:12 - 22:59:01 UTC. Failed events: 93. Error profile: 74 x SignatureVerificationError, 19 x UpstreamHTTP(503). Details: /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742350001

Tao (Backend): Looking at billing-sync logs: after yesterday's deploy we tightened the signature tolerance window and rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Code expects stripe-signature timestamp within 300s. Logs show many events rejected with "SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance" between 22:34-22:38.

Helene (Ops): We rotated the secret during the maintenance window at 22:30 UTC and updated the config in the control plane, but I didn't realize Stripe UI still had the old signing secret for the endpoint. Stripe rotates signing secret gradually; if our verifier only accepts current secret we can end up rejecting in-flight events.

Ethan (Finance): Customers are emailing CS asking why invoice PDFs aren't available. Need a prioritized recovery plan and a CSV of affected customers for CS.

Lina (Payments): I pulled some example Stripe events: evt_1LxYz9MNOphA2 - invoice.payment_succeeded, metadata.external_invoice_ref = "INV-2026-03-23-210". I pushed a sample payload to the backfill queue for testing.

Tao (Backend): Quick fix: I can add dual-secret verification (current + previous) for 12 hours and release a hotfix. Also will change retry semantics: treat NetSuite 409 (externalId already exists) as idempotent and GET the record instead of re-trying create. Preparing PR now.

billing-bot: DEPLOYMENT: billing-sync v2.14.4-hotfix initiated by Tao at 22:46 UTC. CI passed, deploying to prod-canary.

Helene (Ops): While we patch, I'll re-add the previous secret into the environment as a fallback and restart the service. Rolling restart starting now. Will monitor error rate.

billing-bot: ROLLING-RESTART: billing-sync nodes restarted 22:49 - 22:53 UTC. Health checks healthy.

Tao (Backend): Hotfix deployed to prod at 22:55 UTC with dual-secret verification. Adding extra logging for raw stripe-signature header for audit.

Lina (Payments): Before we backfill, note that earlier some NetSuite create attempts returned 500 with partial-create traces in logs. We should coordinate with NetSuite support so we don't produce duplicate or orphan records. Opening case with NetSuite: case NS-9876.

Helene (Ops): I opened NS-9876 with the following note: "Partial create failures during retry loop after webhook rejects - possible external_id collisions. Please advise clearing partial entries and unlocking external_id  keys for safe idempotent re-run." Estimated response 1-3 hours.

Ethan (Finance): Please also export a reconciliation CSV: stripe_event_id, internal_invoice_id (if mapped), customer_email, amount_cents, currency, stripe_status. CS needs it in the next hour.

Tao (Backend): Generating exceptions CSV now. Saved to /finance/recon/ops/1742350001-missing_invoices.csv. Will attach to this thread when ready.

billing-bot: JOB: recon-backfill queued (job_id=rb-1742350001-1).

Lina (Payments): Manual backfill ready to run but holding until NetSuite confirms it's safe to re-run against possibly partial records. Also will dedupe on stripe_event_id and external_invoice_ref to avoid double-creates.

Helene (Ops): NetSuite acknowledged NS-9876: they will clear 9 partial records and add a lock on conflicting external_id for 2 hours while we re-run. ETA 90 minutes.

Ethan (Finance): What's the customer impact window? How many customers affected and any billing charges at risk?

Lina (Payments): 93 events total. Preliminary scan: 88 unique customers, no duplicate charges detected, payments settled in Stripe. Main impact is missing invoice records and PDFs in NetSuite. No disputes yet, but CS should be prepared.

Tao (Backend): Once NetSuite clears partials, I'll run the backfill. Backfill plan: 1) fetch events from the backfill queue, 2) dedupe by stripe_event_id, 3) attempt create -> on 409 fetch existing record, 4) on 5xx mark for manual review. I'll post results here.

billing-bot: BACKFILL: manual-run scheduled (initiated_by=Lina) at 00:17 UTC.

Lina (Payments): Backfill executed at 00:17 UTC. Processing... progress updates below.

billing-bot: BACKFILL-PROGRESS: processed=93, created=84, fetched_existing=9, blocked=0, flagged_manual=0. Detailed CSV: /finance/recon/ops/1742350001-missing_invoices.csv

Helene (Ops): NetSuite confirmed the partials were cleared at 00:10 UTC. Good coordination.

Ethan (Finance): Great work. Please include a short postmortem with root cause: secret rotation + strict timestamp window + retry-as-retryable on 409 + partial create handling. Action items: 1) add pre-rotation checklist and automated sync of signing secrets to Stripe via API, 2) maintain previous secret for 24h fallback, 3) change retry policy for create->409, 4) alert on >10 signature failures in 5m for /webhooks/netsuite, 5) integration test simulating secret rotation.

Tao (Backend): I'll draft the postmortem and link remediation PRs. Immediate PRs: dual-secret verifier, 409->fetch idempotency, extra monitoring alert. ETA draft: EOD.

Lina (Payments): CSV and summary sent to CS: /finance/recon/ops/1742350001-missing_invoices.csv. No customer-facing refunds required.

Helene (Ops): Added alert: webhook.signature.failures threshold rule and Slack escalation to #eng-oncall. Also added runbook step to notify Payments and Finance when rotating webhook secrets.

Ethan (Finance): Thanks team. I'll ping CS and close the ticket once NetSuite confirms final state. Please ping this thread when postmortem is posted. :thumbsup:
